events.title: Chrome Manifest V3 extension platform
events.summary: Google began rolling out Manifest V3 for Chrome extensions in January 2021 — replacing persistent background pages with service workers and tightening content-blocking APIs.
events.about: Manifest V3 changed how ad blockers, password managers, and dev tools hook into Chrome: extensions became more sandboxed and declarative. The shift sparked years of debate between Google (security, performance) and extension authors (filtering power), and other Chromium browsers inherited the model.

narrative.whyChosen: MV3 redefined what browser extensions could do in the world's most-used browser.
narrative.whyImportant: It forced every extension developer to rewrite for service workers and new permission models.
narrative.problemSolved: Google argued legacy extension APIs were too permissive and hurt battery life and security.

events.title: Dario Amodei co-founds Anthropic
events.summary: Dario Amodei co-founded Anthropic in early 2021 after leaving OpenAI — building the Claude model family with a safety focus.
events.about: Anthropic became OpenAI's primary rival in frontier chat and API models — Claude 2, 3, and 3.5. Amodei's team emphasized constitutional AI and long-context products for enterprise developers.

narrative.whyChosen: Anthropic diversified the frontier LLM market beyond OpenAI.
narrative.whyImportant: Competition accelerated safety research and developer choice.
narrative.problemSolved: Enterprises wanted alternative LLM vendors with strong safety positioning.
